description:
Original hentai series from Akio Takami.

There are people I admire. No, this is not just amazed, but it's love! I had no idea in my life there could be someone I craved, loved, and made me nervous. She is my Misaki-sensei teacher. At night, I tried to venture to come and meet her at his home. Then I tried to ask her to teach me about her body.

(Source: Nekopoi and Has Been Translated)
